name: computer-use-impl
description: The computer-use@1 SERVICE HOST (provider `registry`): it owns the driver registry, the execution-time selection policy (explicit provider, else configured default + ordered fallback, else the single usable driver), the seam bounds (screenshot byte cap, call deadline, clipboard inline cap), the typed delegation of an unimplemented half and the optional sandbox@1 gate. Drivers are SEPARATE plugins that register themselves here; this plugin imports no driver and touches no desktop, so the manifest declares execution none.

config.description: Which driver answers by default, the fallback chain, and the bounds of one call.

provider.description: Default driver id (e.g. x11). Absent: take the single usable registered driver, or fail with computer-use.ambiguous.

fallback.description: Ordered driver ids tried when the default cannot run (a dead chain is a typed error, never a silent switch).

screenshotDir.description: Directory a screenshot FILE is written to (default: <tmpdir>/workbench-computer-use). The answer is always a path, never inline base64.

maxImageBytes.description: Byte cap of ONE screenshot file: an image above it is a typed computer-use.oversized error naming the real size, never a silent drop.

timeoutMs.description: Wall-clock bound of one call to the desktop.

maxTextChars.description: Inline character cap of a clipboard read.
